definitions.question: Both orange expansion boxes filled in the same forecast window: outer-boundary touch versus strict exceedance.
definitions.windows: 03:00–05:00,05:00–08:30,08:30–16:00 America/New_York. Include starting candle, exclude endpoint-opening candle. No use of later windows.
definitions.orange: Freeze H/L of19:30-to-decision completed candles plus known decision open. Upper outer target H+mean(max(futureHigh−historicalH,0)/historicalAVR)×currentAVR; lower target L−mean(max(historicalL−futureLow,0)/historicalAVR)×currentAVR. Zeros remain in averages.
definitions.precision: Production serializes cutoff extrema and forecast point distances to6decimals; no tick rounding. EPS1e-9 only for floating arithmetic.
definitions.touch: Within that one window: high>=upper outer target AND low<=lower outer target. Strict exceedances are included in touches.
definitions.exceed: Within that one window: high>upper outer target AND low<lower outer target. Wick tests; no outside close required.
definitions.baseline: New high+new low means strict breaches of the original cutoff H/L only. It does not mean both forecast expansions filled.
definitions.earlyRecipe: Established historical screenshot/research protocol: up to50 nearest earlier matches, same prior-NY BBOX quarter and previous-hour behavior, numeric similarity in printed range/AVR,up/AVR,down/AVR,BBOX position and position in running range. No extra tags or earlier-checkpoint filters.
definitions.nyRecipe: Four separate established Own/Prior Exact/Wide Asia/London closing-position cohorts, all eligible earlier matches. No pooling of these methods as independent days.
definitions.chronology: Rebuild earlier-only cohorts with the production matching engine and clean nullable OHLC. Every cohort date is strictly before the forecast date. Reconstruct orange widths from those cohorts, then independently audit their decision-open means against raw candles. Save cohort changes against the previous reconstruction.
definitions.denominator: Headline needs at least50 earlier matched dates, complete outcome data and two strictly positive orange box heights. Sparse forecasts retained as supplementary selectable data. Zero-height pairs reported separately, never counted as automatic fills.
definitions.time: First touch/exceed candle open timestamp; observable at candle close5minutes later. Same-candle both-side hits have unknown intrabar order.
definitions.limitations: Exploratory historical frequencies, not trade win rates. Earlier-only fits prevent self/future fitting; all history has already been studied. Wilson95% intervals do not adjust for serial dependence or multiple comparisons. Changing live inputs, tags, checkpoints or matching recipe can change the boxes.
